ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-3,
Community Shopping District; RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) Districts;
and RM-5, Residential Multi-Unit Districts symbols and indications as shown on Map No.
2-J in the area bound by:

      South Millard Avenue; West Fifth Avenue; South Central Park Boulevard; a line 141 feet
      north of the intersection of South Central Park Boulevard and West Fifth Avenue as
      measured along the east right-of-way line of South Central Park Boulevard; the alley
      next east of and parallel to South Central Park Boulevard; West Fifth Avenue; South St.
      Louis Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to West Fifth Avenue and extended
      east where no alley exists; a line 75 feet east of and parallel to South St. Louis Avenue;
      a line 111 feet south of and parallel to West Jackson Boulevard; a line 125 feet east of
      and parallel to South St. Louis Avenue; West Fifth Avenue; South St. Louis Avenue; the
      alley next south of and parallel to West Fifth Avenue; a line 472.18 feet west of and
      parallel to South St. Louis Avenue; West Van Buren Street; South Central Park Avenue;
      and the alley next south of and parallel to West Fifth Avenue,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           ____________________________
                                                           Jason C. Ervin
                                                           Alderman, 28th Ward




Common Address:
3501 – 3631 W. Fifth Avenue
331-339 S. Central Park Boulevard
3454 – 3460 W. Fifth Avenue
